results.title: 📹 Flamengo thrash Mirassol away, tighten grip on Brasileiro lead
Irish fans praised for standout support of their athletes at European championships in Birmingham
results.description: BIRMINGHAM, England (AP) — Paul O’Donnell was struggling in the marathon on Sunday morning. The Irish fans got him home.

results.title: Short Interest in LATAM Airlines Group S.A. (NYSE:LTM) Increases By 89.0%
results.description: LATAM Airlines Group S.A. (NYSE:LTM – Get Free Report) saw a significant growth in short interest during the month of July. As of July 31st, there was short interest totaling 3,397,117 shares, a growth of 89.0% from the July 15th total of 1,797,135 shares. Currently, 1.3% of the shares of the company are sold short.
